title: Show each project's department
prompt: Return project, the name of each project, and department, the name of the department it belongs to. Sort by project. The starter joins the two tables on the wrong column.
hints: Which column of projects holds the id of a department?
The ON condition must compare the department's id with the project's department_id.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Pairs every project with every department.
Reads each name from the wrong table.

feedback: Pick one project, look up its department_id in schema.sql, and check that your result shows that department.
